correctness.rationale: For n≥3 the clockwise and counterclockwise edges are distinct, the uniform distribution is stationary, and Q^T is the stationary reversed generator. Each of the n undirected bonds contributes ((a−b)/n) log(a/b) to the hidden entropy production. For 3≤n≤5, after taking the smaller label class it has at most two sites; the reflection i↦u+v−i swaps two marked sites, or i↦2u−i fixes a singleton. Either preserves the binary output and conjugates Q to Q^T, proving reversibility of every finite-dimensional distribution. At n=6, I independently expanded the unequal-lag cubic term by counting displacement triples from the marked set {0,1,3}. In the difference f^T QD_f Q² f−f^T Q²D_f Q f, scalar diagonal terms cancel (f is binary and the symmetric mixed product cancels); among off-diagonal jump triples, only (+,+,+) and (−,−,−) have unequal counts under exchanging the one- and two-jump blocks, with signed counts +1 and −1 respectively. Thus the difference is a³−b³. One-boundary terms agree by D_f f=f and f^T D_f=f^T; the degree-two mixed term is symmetric. The stationary factor 1/6 and factorial 1/2 give (a³−b³)ts(s−t)/12 at cubic order, hence exactly (a³−b³)ε³/6 for t=ε,s=2ε. The analytic remainder implies a nonzero signal at sufficiently short such lags whenever a≠b; a=b is reversible. Binary stationarity identifies the off-diagonal pairs and, for equal-spaced triples, forces 001=100 and 011=110 by comparing shifted equal-pair marginals and subtracting the shared constant triple. Subtracting the common 1111 event proves the stated four-frame identity. No result about arbitrary finite sampling intervals, heterogeneous rates or noisy labels is used. The frozen self-review's 453-assertion count omits the five final checks visible in the supplied script; the discrepancy is peripheral to the analytic result.

Chen already uses the same unequal-gap triple statistic and proves the three-hidden-state impossibility for deterministic binary labels; the same-day four-state result treats a larger, heterogeneous model and bears directly on why the homogeneity restriction matters. The assay, the bare chirality of the witness, and two/equal-three binary stationarity identities are not claimed as independent novelty.

value.rationale: The exact point at which spatial homogeneity stops concealing a stationary current from every binary label is a natural identifiability boundary. The lower bound concerns the whole observed law, while the attaining example needs only three unequally spaced snapshots and provides the leading sign and scale for any nonzero bias. The result is useful as a controlled test case for separating hidden dissipation from observable reversibility; it does not promise inference robustness, feasible precision at arbitrary lag, or the same threshold for other chains.
